articles.title: Security researchers used Anthropic's Claude to hack OpenAI's internal systems in under 72 hours
articles.description: Three security researchers used Anthropic's Claude models to break into OpenAI's internal systems through its community forum in less than 72 hours. According to the team, Opus 5 succeeded where its predecessor couldn't bypass a common security measure. The attack shows how newer AI models can cut the time and expertise needed to exploit security flaws. articles.description: arXiv:2609.19499v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Test-time scaling can improve large language model reasoning by generating and combining multiple candidate responses. In sampling-based methods, the inference budget is often described by the number of generated candidates, N. However, N tells us how many candidates are generated, not how they are executed. The same candidate budget can be produced in one batched generation call or split across several sequential calls with smaller batch sizes....
